_comment: Shipped default role-to-model policy for the pstack plugin. Every value starts as 'inherit-parent' (run the role on the parent session's model) because this repo has no recorded per-role operator picks yet, only the single global default in this machine's ~/.claude/settings.json. Run /setup-pstack to replace these with real detected slugs per role; it writes ~/.claude/pstack-models.md (imported from CLAUDE.md), which every skill checks before falling back to this file's defaults.
